note: SYNTHETIC. Simplified shape loosely modeled on Snowflake INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES/COLUMNS. Not a real export and not produced by a Snowflake connection.

tables.name: FACT_ORDERS
tables.comment: One row per order (grain: ORDER_ID). Loaded incrementally by mapping m_ORDERS_STG_TO_FACT_ORDERS using an upsert keyed on ORDER_ID. Clustered by ORDER_DATE.

columns.name: ORDER_SK
columns.comment: Surrogate key generated from sequence DW.SEQ_ORDER_SK.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SK
columns.comment: FK to DW.DIM_CUSTOMER current row. -1 means unknown or guest customer.

columns.name: NET_AMOUNT
columns.comment: GROSS_AMOUNT minus discount and tax. Derived in EXP_DERIVE_AMOUNTS.

columns.name: SOURCE_UPDATED_AT
columns.comment: UPDATED_AT of the source row that produced this version.

columns.name: ETL_BATCH_ID
columns.comment: Batch that last wrote the row; joins to AUDIT.JOB_RUN_LOG.

tables.name: DIM_CUSTOMER
tables.comment: Customer dimension kept as SCD Type 2. Exactly one row per CUSTOMER_ID should have IS_CURRENT = 'Y'. Surrogate key -1 is a seeded 'Unknown customer' row.

columns.name: SIGNUP_DATE
columns.comment: Type 1 attribute, overwritten in place on all versions.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.comment: First business date this version is valid.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.comment: Last business date this version is valid; 9999-12-31 for the current row.

columns.name: ROW_HASH
columns.comment: SHA2 of the tracked attributes, used for change detection.

tables.name: DIM_PRODUCT
tables.comment: Product dimension, SCD Type 1. Fully rebuilt every night from RAW.PRODUCTS_STG by m_PRODUCTS_FULL_REFRESH.

columns.name: PRODUCT_SK
columns.comment: Surrogate key derived as a hash of PRODUCT_ID so it stays stable across rebuilds.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.comment: Discontinued SKUs are kept with IS_ACTIVE = FALSE.

tables.name: FACT_RETURNS
tables.comment: One row per returned line (grain: RETURN_ID + PRODUCT_ID). Loaded incrementally by m_RETURNS_STG_TO_FACT_RETURNS.

columns.name: ORDER_SK
columns.comment: FK to DW.FACT_ORDERS, looked up on ORDER_ID. -1 when the order has not arrived yet.

tables.name: DAILY_SALES
tables.comment: Daily sales by region and product category. Secure view over DW.FACT_ORDERS, DW.DIM_CUSTOMER and DW.FACT_RETURNS; net sales subtract refunds.

tables.name: ETL_CONTROL
tables.comment: One row per incremental job holding its high-water mark. The watermark is only advanced after the target load commits successfully.

columns.name: LAST_EXTRACT_TS
columns.comment: High-water mark: max source timestamp loaded by the last successful run.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_START_TS
columns.comment: When set, the next run extracts from this timestamp instead of LAST_EXTRACT_TS (used for backfills). Cleared after a successful run.

columns.name: LOOKBACK_MINUTES
columns.comment: Overlap subtracted from the watermark to catch late-committed source rows.

columns.name: UPDATED_AT
columns.comment: When the control row last changed.

tables.name: JOB_RUN_LOG
tables.comment: One row per session run: status, row counts and error text. Written by the workflow's post-session commands.

columns.name: ROWS_REJECTED
columns.comment: Rows written to the reject file.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.comment: First error reported by the session.
